Path 1, networkingGOALS §3.6

Istio

The mesh direction we're already committed to.

WHAT IT IS

A service mesh providing mTLS identity, traffic policy and telemetry, in sidecar or ambient mode, with multicluster east-west gateways.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Locality-aware failover sheds load to the remote region on outlier detection. Coinbase, with 79 prod clusters, named ambient as their direction. Multicluster discovery is O(n²): fine at two clusters, a cap beyond.

WHERE WE STAND

Committed. Open item: sidecar versus ambient, in ISTIO-VS-GATEWAY-API.md. Budget mesh telemetry cardinality as a cost line.

Coinbase, mesh-native mTLS; "Breaking the O(n²) Wall" (Microsoft), KubeCon NA 2026
